packs.name: Superpowers Meta Authoring Pack
packs.description: Superpowers meta skills for authoring new tested skills.
useCases: Author new agent skills that follow the Superpowers conventions and are validated by tests.

packs.name: Superpowers Quality Debugging Pack
packs.description: Superpowers skills for root-cause debugging and disciplined issue investigation.
useCases: Investigate bugs with the Superpowers systematic-debugging methodology instead of guess-and-check fixes.
examplePrompts: Use systematic debugging to find the root cause of this intermittent failure before proposing any fix.

packs.name: Technical Writer Pack
packs.description: Workflows for coding agents producing engineering documentation: clear technical writing, architecture decision records, codebase archaeology and onboarding guides, and source-grounded, accurate references.
useCases: Create source-grounded docs for APIs, systems, workflows, and onboarding.
Turn codebase archaeology into concise architecture notes, diagrams, and ADRs.
Review technical docs for accuracy, audience fit, completeness, and maintenance risk.
Prepare agent-friendly prompts, runbooks, and references for Codex and Claude Code users.
examplePrompts: Write source-grounded documentation for this feature, including behavior, configuration, and examples.
Create an ADR for this design decision with context, options, tradeoffs, and consequences.
Review these docs for technical accuracy, missing prerequisites, unclear steps, and stale claims.
Turn this codebase area into an onboarding guide with key files, flows, commands, and gotchas.

packs.name: TypeScript Engineer Pack
packs.description: Workflows for coding agents writing production TypeScript: strict typing and precise type contracts, test-driven development, interface design, dependency hygiene, and monorepo-aware change scoping.
useCases: Write strictly-typed TypeScript with precise type contracts between modules.
Design stable interfaces and evolve them without breaking consumers.
Keep dependencies and monorepo package boundaries healthy while scoping changes safely.
examplePrompts: Tighten the types in this module — eliminate any, narrow the unions, and make invalid states unrepresentable.
Design the type contract between this frontend and its API client, then implement it test-first.
